claim: Footnote and endnote ids -1 and 0 are reserved for the separator and continuation-separator notes and never name a note a reference can point at.

sources.locator: wml.xsd CT_FtnEdn/@w:id is ST_DecimalNumber with no facet, so the reserved ids are prose only; the @w:type enumeration ST_FtnEdn carries the separator kinds

fixtures.assertion: Neither note appears in the rendered note list, and a w:footnoteReference to id 1 resolves to the third note.
